logline: 왕비의 거울이 다른 이름을 부르자, 어린 공주가 숲으로 보내진다.
destination: 숲속 일곱 사람의 오두막 — 공주가 숨어든 자리
protagonist: 검은 머리에 흰 살결의 어린 공주
anchor: a young girl with black hair and very pale skin, plain patched dress
palette: deep green, cold stone grey, deep velvet red, warm amber, snow white

snow.label: 공주
snow.desc: a girl of about fourteen, straight black hair, very pale skin, plain patched grey dress

queen.label: 왕비
queen.desc: a tall woman in her forties, dark hair coiled under a thin crown, deep red velvet gown

huntsman.label: 사냥꾼
huntsman.desc: a broad bearded man in a leather jerkin and fur cloak, hunting knife at his belt

dwarfs.label: 일곱 사람
dwarfs.desc: seven short bearded men in rough woollen coats and caps, pickaxes over their shoulders

peddler.label: 낡은 숄의 노파
peddler.desc: a stooped old woman in a ragged brown shawl, basket on her arm, face half hidden
peddler.avoid: 왕비와 같은 사람으로 보이지 않게 한다

castle.label: 성 안
castle.desc: a cold stone castle chamber, narrow windows, heavy tapestries

forest.label: 깊은 숲
forest.desc: towering mossy trunks, ferns underfoot, little light reaching the ground

cottage.label: 오두막
cottage.desc: a tiny forest cottage with seven small windows, low door, smoke from the chimney

beats.beat: 왕비가 거울 앞에 서서 제 모습을 본다.
beats.visual: a crowned woman in dark velvet before a tall ornate mirror in a stone chamber
beats.motion: her reflection steadies in the glass

beats.visual: a tall mirror clouding over before a crowned woman, a faint pale face forming in it

beats.beat: 어린 공주가 부엌 바닥을 닦고 있다.
beats.visual: a black-haired girl in a patched dress scrubbing flagstones in a castle kitchen
beats.motion: her cloth moves steadily across the stone

beats.visual: a crowned woman leaning close to a bearded huntsman in a dim corridor
beats.motion: her hand tightens steadily on his sleeve

beats.visual: a bearded huntsman walking a black-haired girl deep between mossy trees
beats.motion: they move steadily deeper along the path

beats.visual: a bearded huntsman lowering a knife, his back turning toward the dark trees
beats.motion: his shoulders sink steadily as he turns

beats.visual: a black-haired girl running between towering mossy trunks, branches closing behind
beats.motion: she runs steadily deeper into the trees

beats.visual: a tiny cottage with seven small windows glowing in a forest clearing at dusk
a black-haired girl seated at a very small table with seven little bowls
beats.motion: steam rises steadily from the bowls

beats.visual: seven short bearded men crowded in a cottage doorway looking at a seated girl
beats.motion: they press steadily forward in the doorway

beats.visual: a crowned woman pulling a ragged shawl over her velvet gown before a mirror
beats.motion: the shawl settles steadily over her shoulders

beats.visual: a stooped woman in a ragged shawl at a cottage door, a basket on her arm
beats.motion: her knuckles rap steadily at the door

beats.visual: a stooped woman holding out a red apple to a black-haired girl in a doorway
beats.motion: the apple moves steadily toward the girl

beats.beat: 빈 오두막 앞에 사과 하나가 놓여 있다.
beats.visual: a single red apple lying on a cottage doorstep, seven small windows dark behind
beats.motion: shadow creeps steadily across the doorstep

withheld: 사과를 베어 문 뒤에 벌어지는 일과, 공주를 깨우는 것
